conf.description: Tanium threat-response / api-pull: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-ingest-pipeline).

conf.comment: tanium / threat-response / api-pull. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic ingest pipeline decodes this downstream (Elastic httpjson/CEL input + logs-tanium.threat_response@custom (no stock API-pull path in the Tanium integration)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
